detailed_descriptions.en: Evenicle - Next Fragment: Medica , the sequel to Alicesoft's hit RPG Evenicle , is a fantasy RPG set in a dangerous world ravaged by wild monsters where only rare few individuals wielding forbidden skills dare to challenge them. However, with every skill these brave warriors use, a terrible diseases eats away at their bodies. This affliction is known as Hero Syndrome . Enter Alex , a young doctor and the game's protagonist, who happens to be blessed with a long forgotten healing skill known as " Medica "—the only hope to curing the diseases ravaging the world! Explore a six different continents of a vast 3d world with a party as heroic as it is lovely! Dive into engaging turn-based RPG combat with unique skills to discover to customize your party! Save your party and the world from the ravages of Hero Syndrome and enjoy some laughs along the way!
